class: When a third party sends the browser back to ONE registered redirect URL for more than one flow (login, and a later action such as placing an order basket), a callback written for the first flow treats every arrival as that flow: a return from the other flow fails the first flow's checks (no state we issued) and the user sees that flow's error - here a login error right after placing real orders - or, if a check happens to pass, the handler runs the first flow's side effects (token exchange, session replace) on the wrong event.
mechanism: Kite's basket docs (https://kite.trade/docs/connect/v3/basket/, read 2026-10-17): 'Once the user is done placing orders, the basket will redirect back to your registered `redirect_login` along with a `request_key`, exactly like login.' backend/ofo_app/routes/broker.py kite_callback (lines ~229-262 on main at eb38b14): `user_ref = rt.states.consume(state, request.cookies.get(STATE_COOKIE))` then `if user_ref is None: return _refused_redirect(request, rt, "broker_state_invalid")` - a basket return carries no state we issued, so it is refused to the login-refusal page.

first_seen.where: GC-2e item 6 (W-105) research, before any real basket return
first_seen.evidence: W-105 research agent: WebFetch of the Kite basket docs page + Read of broker.py kite_callback; the live return shape (whether state is absent, whether a cancelled basket returns status=success) is unverified until GC-3's first basket.

fix: W-105: a callback hit with NO state query parameter is a basket return -> redirect to the frontend page /execution/returned (shows only 'Check with Zerodha'), never exchanging request_token, never touching the state store; a hit with any state value keeps the login path. Live confirmation at GC-3's first basket.

detection.note: Becomes guarded when W-105's callback tests (no-state hit -> landing, exchange count 0, rows unchanged; empty state= still refused) merge. Sweep: the only shared-redirect handler in this repo is kite_callback (grep of backend for redirect handlers, 2026-10-17).

occurrences.evidence: broker.py kite_callback refuses a no-state return with broker_state_invalid; Kite docs say the basket returns to the registered redirect URL
